title: Store skeleton: open/create, WAL, migrations; sqlite-vec + FTS5 walking skeleton green on every CI target
description:
**Files:** `Cargo.toml` (add `sqlite-vec = "=0.1.10-alpha.4"`, exact pin: alpha crate); `src/store/mod.rs`, `src/store/migrations.rs` (new module, isolated from src/cli and src/adapters); `src/lib.rs` (pub mod store); `src/spec/ch02_querying.rs` (status); `tests/steps/store_steps.rs` (make the scenarios green).

**Specs turned green:** `04_store.feature` — remove its @wip when every scenario passes.

**Acceptance:** `Store::open(path)` plus default-path resolution (BOTSPY_HOME/$HOME → ~/.botspy/store.db); WAL + busy_timeout pragmas; `meta` table with versioned embedded DDL v1 — sessions, messages, parts with projected filter columns (agent, project_id, started_at, last_activity_at, message_count, role, timestamp, turn_id, part kind, text projection) plus lossless `session_json`/`message_json` serde columns; indexes on activity, agent, project, kind. sqlite-vec registered via `sqlite3_auto_extension` before connections open. Walking-skeleton unit tests: `vec_version()` smoke, vec0 create+insert+k-NN, FTS5 create+match (bundled SQLite ships FTS5 — the test asserts it so a target without it fails loudly; no silent LIKE fallback).

**Cross-platform gate:** this task is the sqlite-vec proof point — the crate compiles sqlite-vec.c from source via cc, the same build path as rusqlite's bundled SQLite, so the matrix should hold; the PR's CI must be fully green on Linux x86/arm gnu, musl x86/arm (cross), macOS 14 + 15-intel, and Windows MSVC before this task closes. If a target fails, stop and report on this task.

Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Store skeleton implemented on `feat/local-store` (PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/BotSpy/pull/4, CI pending before merge): `04_store.feature` green, `@wip` removed; WAL + DDL v1 + default path + lazy session iteration + minimal `ingest_sessions`. Walking-skeleton unit tests prove vec_version(), vec0 k-NN, FTS5. Deviation: sqlite-vec pinned to stable 0.1.9 — the planned 0.1.10-alpha.4 (and alpha.3) are broken upstream: the crate defaults SQLITE_VEC_ENABLE_DISKANN=1 but the shipped tarball omits sqlite-vec-diskann.c, so it cannot compile on any target.

comments.author: home
